about: Order of the main tables, supplementary tables and figures. It sets their numbers; an absent item is skipped and later ones move up. Keys are the ones render_manuscript_body takes. Since v0.33.0 the tuning comparison (workbook Table 3) is not printed; its values still feed the text. Since v0.33.3 the CONSORT table (workbook Table S3) is not printed, because Figure 1 shows the same steps down to the analysed cohort, and the length-of-stay table is printed with the sites as columns ('transpose'); the workbook keeps both as delivered.
